name: Coimperta
text: Coimperta is the plural form of Compert, an Irish word for conception, the act of begetting. The word names a genre of tales about how heroes are conceived and born. The plural gathers many such birth-tales of heroes under a single heading. See Compert.

attributes.value: plural of the Irish word for conception

okr.objective: Coimperta is the plural of Compert, the genre name for tales of heroic conception.
key_results: Coimperta is the plural form of Compert, an Irish word for conception, the act of begetting.
The word names a genre of tales about the conceptions and births of heroes.
